title: Weekly sync prep: serving-runtime / infra / console - personal notes (Evan)
content:
Quick prep notes for upcoming weekly sync (timebox 45m). - goal: align infra/serving-runtime/console on rollouts, outstanding infra debt, and action item ownership

Agenda (rough)
- 0-5m: quick wins + shoutouts (Aisha)
- 5-15m: metrics snapshot (latency / errors / capacity) (Evan)
  - 99p latency for text-gen on p3 remains ~370ms for short seqs (improved since kernel1 change)
  - token throughput: avg 120k tokens/s across pool, spike pattern at 10:30 UTC on Tue (investigate autoscaler)
  - error budget burn: 1.2% in last 7d, largely from model-fallback logic returning 500s
- 15-25m: canary rollout plan for kernel-selection v2 (Miguel)
  - checklist: rollout percentages, monitoring hooks, failback thresholds
- 25-35m: console UX for per-route cost breakdown (Priya)
  - blocking: backend endpoint /metrics/v2 needs pagination fix (JIRA-ENG-1427)
- 35-40m: open blockers & escalations
- 40-45m: action items + next steps (Evan)

Notes / talking points (scratchy)
- Autoscaler: saw double-scaling events when batch arrival pattern shifted; probably race in scale-down TTL. Suggest adding jitter to scale-down job and increase cooldown to 90s. (TODO: open PR with test harness)
- Model fallback 500s: related to cache invalidation when rolling models. Possibly KV cache eviction not propagating to dedicated pools. Hypothesis: eviction race when model hash changes during in-flight requests. (Action: add guard + metric around cache-eviction latency)
- Kernel-selection v2: Miguel says CPU-bound tests look good; need e2e on real long-context workloads before 10% canary. Plan: start 5% -> 20% -> 50% with automated rollback on >0.8% error bump or >20ms 95p latency increase. (Linked PR above)
- Console cost breakdown: Priya wants per-route per-model token breakdown and sampling UI for high-cost outliers. Backend pagination is causing slow queries on heavy accounts; MVP: limit to top-20 routes w/ sample; follow-up to expand.

Action items (tracked)
- Evan: create autoscaler reproduction harness + test case for scale-down race. due: 2026-04-06. status: in_progress. linked: github issue #876
- Miguel: start 5% canary for kernel-selection v2 on 2026-04-01, add rollback runbook. due: 2026-04-01. status: ready_to_run. linked: JIRA-ENG-1427
- Priya: prototype top-20 route cost UI and sample backend endpoint change. due: 2026-04-08. status: in_progress. linked: confluence:cost-breakdown-mvp
- Aisha: follow up with SRE on k8s node drain flaps reported last week; get incident notes. due: 2026-03-31. status: todo
- Miguel + Evan: instrument KV cache eviction latency metric + alert if eviction >200ms for 5m window. due: 2026-04-05. status: todo

Parking lot / not for this week
- Long-term: pre-warming pools vs autoscaler cost tradeoffs (start an RFC Q2)
- Investigate adaptive quantization profiles per-model per-tenant (research item)

Prep asks (for the meeting)
- Miguel: bring current canary configs and exact metric names for rollback triggers
- Priya: bring screenshots of proposed UI and a list of sample accounts to sanity-check top-20 approach
- SRE (Aisha): incident notes + timeline for node drain flaps

Quick links to paste in meeting chat
- Canary runbook (draft): https://confluence.company/eng/canary-runbooks/kernel-v2
- Autoscaler issue: JIRA-ENG-876
- Kernel-selection PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/452

Extras / personal TODOs (notes to self)
- Follow up with infra-cost team on 1M-token-per-route being misattributed in console (file bug with billing team if confirmed)
- Add explicit note in release checklist to pause autoscaler tuning during model rollout windows

Tone: keep short, action-oriented. Expect to push most detailed technical discussions to breakout channel after sync (15-20m deep dive).

End of notes.
